name: Sarita Jenamani

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Sarita Jenamani is an Austria-based poet, translator and editor of Indian origin. Her work moves among English, Odia and German, and includes translations of Rilke, Trakl and Rose Ausländer into Hindi and Odia. Alongside her poetry, she has worked on Words & Worlds and edited Still We Sing, an anthology addressing violence against women in South Asia. Her collection Silent Conversations / Unterhaltungen in Stille appeared with the Theodor Kramer Gesellschaft in 2024.

Her contribution here brings philosophical questioning close to the experience of displacement. “An Incomprehensible Process” imagines people held within life’s frame, at once exhibits and onlookers. The accompanying “First Rain in Vienna” turns the absence of a familiar earth-scent into an awakening of memory. Its small growth-images end with loss taking root, giving an abstract condition a sharply sensory form.
